text_blocks.snippet: Holiday Heart Syndrome (HHS) refers to irregular heart rhythms, specifically atrial fibrillation (AFib), triggered by excessive alcohol consumption, particularly during holidays or social gatherings. Common symptoms include heart palpitations (feeling like the heart is racing or fluttering), shortness of breath, dizziness, and chest pain or discomfort.
